desc:
🍕 WELCOME TO VERITY'S PIZZERIA! 🍕

You've been trapped inside Verity's Pizzeria, and something is seriously WRONG! 😱 Verity has gone CRAZY and is hunting down anyone who tries to escape! Can you survive the terrifying obstacles and make it out ALIVE?!

🏃 RUN from the EVIL Verity!
🍕 EXPLORE the creepy pizzeria!
🔥 ESCAPE challenging obstacles and deadly traps!
🏆 REACH the end and claim your victory!

😨 Do you have what it takes to ESCAPE VERITY'S PIZZERIA?!

⭐ LIKE the game for more updates!
❤️ FAVORITE to support us!
👥 INVITE your friends to escape together!
